description: Interactive Campus Map page and all Admin pages (analytics dashboard, campus configuration, timetable management, complaint management, optimization, what-if simulation, energy dashboard, ML forecasts, reports). Depends on FEAT-003 (core frontend infrastructure). Independent of FEAT-005 (faculty/student pages). All pages use TanStack Query for data fetching and the UI component library from FEAT-003.
steps: Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/CampusMap.tsx (accessible to all roles): Three-panel layout: left panel = building selector (cards with building name/code/floor count), center panel = floor tabs + blueprint display, right panel = room detail slide-in. Building selector fetches GET /api/buildings. Floor tabs render floor numbers; selecting a floor shows that floor's blueprint image (Floor.blueprintUrl served from /uploads/blueprints/). Over the blueprint image, render an SVG overlay positioned absolutely; for each room that has coordinatesX/coordinatesY, render a circle marker colored by status: AVAILABLE=#10B981, OCCUPIED=#EF4444, MAINTENANCE=#F59E0B, RESERVED=#3B82F6, TEMP_UNAVAILABLE=#EAB308. Each marker also has a text label (room code) and icon (use Lucide: CheckCircle/XCircle/Wrench/Lock/Clock). Clicking a marker opens the right detail panel showing: room code, name, type badge, status badge, capacity, department, equipment list, current occupancy from timetable. If no blueprint uploaded, show placeholder grid of room cards. Add search bar at top that filters markers and highlights matched room. Guest role: only show public room types (CLASSROOM,LAB,RESTROOM,LIBRARY,SEMINAR_HALL,AUDITORIUM,OFFICE).

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/map/RoomMarker.tsx: individual SVG marker component with status color, icon, tooltip on hover showing room name and current status text (not just color). Keyboard-focusable (tabIndex=0, onKeyDown Enter = click). ARIA label: 'room code, status'.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/map/RoomDetailPanel.tsx: slide-in right panel (translate-x animation). Shows all room fields, status badge with color+text+icon, equipment tags, a Reserve button (faculty+admin only) that opens reservation modal, a Report Issue button (all authenticated).
Create campus-x/frontend/src/components/map/StatusLegend.tsx: small legend bar at bottom of map showing all 5 statuses with color swatch, icon, and text label.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/AnalyticsDashboard.tsx: 4 stat cards at top (Total Rooms, Available Now, Active Complaints, Today's Classes with utilization % badge). Below: 4 Recharts charts: (1) Bar chart — room utilization by building (x=building name, y=utilization%). (2) Line chart — complaint trends by week (last 8 weeks, x=week, y=count, series for OPEN/RESOLVED). (3) Pie chart — room type distribution (segment per RoomType). (4) Area chart — energy consumption last 30 days (x=date, y=kWh, one series per building). Below charts: Alerts panel — list of active alerts from GET /api/analytics/alerts, each with severity icon (Lucide AlertTriangle/AlertCircle), description, timestamp, action link. All data via TanStack Query with 30s refetch interval. Skeleton loading state for each section.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/BuildingManagement.tsx: tab layout with Buildings list and Add Building form. Buildings list: table with columns building name, code, floors count, rooms count, actions (Edit, View Rooms, Delete). Add Building form: fields building name, code, number of floors (submits POST /api/buildings). Clicking Edit opens modal with same form prefilled. Clicking View Rooms navigates to /admin/rooms?buildingId=X.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/FloorBlueprintUpload.tsx: page reached from BuildingManagement. Shows building name and list of floors. For each floor: current blueprint thumbnail (or 'No blueprint' placeholder), Upload Blueprint button (FileInput component, POST to /api/buildings/:id/blueprint with floor number). After upload, show preview of uploaded image.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/RoomManagement.tsx: filterable table of rooms (filter by building, floor, type, status, department). Table columns: code, name, type badge, status badge, capacity, building/floor, actions (Edit Status, Edit Details, View on Map). Add Room button opens side modal with form: code, name, type select, capacity, floor select (loads from selected building), department, equipment (multi-tag input), accessibility textarea, coordinatesX, coordinatesY. PATCH room status inline from table with reason input.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/TimetableManagement.tsx: semester selector at top (GET /api/timetable/semesters). Below: department+class selector. Main view: week grid Mon-Sat rows × 8-period columns. Each cell shows subject code, faculty name, room code. Cells with conflicts highlighted in red with tooltip. Add Entry button on empty cell opens modal with form: class, subject, faculty (select from dept), room (shows available rooms for that period), day, period. Import CSV button opens upload modal with template download link. Conflicts panel on right listing detected conflicts with resolution suggestions.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/ComplaintManagement.tsx: table with filters (status, category, building, date range, priority). Columns: autoId, category icon, building/room, reported by, priority badge, status badge, created date, actions. Clicking a row expands inline panel with full description, image (if any), ComplaintUpdate timeline, Assign To select (faculty list), Update Status select with resolution text field. Stats row at top showing counts per status.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/OptimizationPage.tsx: 'Analyse Semester' button triggers GET /api/optimization/suggest. Shows efficiency score (% of optimal). Table with columns: current room, class, strength, room capacity, utilization%, suggested room, reason, expected improvement. Checkboxes to select suggestions. Apply Selected button opens confirmation modal showing summary, then POST /api/optimization/apply. Toast on success.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/SimulationPage.tsx: scenario selector (3 radio options: Room Unavailable, Add Class, Increase Strength). Each scenario shows relevant parameter inputs (room selector / class+period / class+strength). Run Simulation button. Results section: summary card with conflict count + affected count. Expandable cards for Conflicts (red), Affected Classes (orange), Suggestions (green). Clear disclaimer banner: 'This simulation is read-only and does not affect live data.'

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/EnergyDashboard.tsx: building selector + date range picker. Area chart (last 30 days, kWh per building). Building comparison bar chart (total kWh). Anomalies panel (flagged records with building, date, hour, consumption vs expected). Drill-down: click building → floor-level breakdown table.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/MLForecasts.tsx: three cards: Demand Forecast (7-day room demand prediction, bar chart), Energy Forecast (24h predicted kWh, area chart), Maintenance Alerts (table of rooms with high maintenance probability). Disclaimer banner on every chart: 'Predictions based on synthetic demonstration data.' Run Forecast buttons for each. Loading skeleton while fetching.

Create campus-x/frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: report type selector (5 types). Date range inputs. Generate Report button (opens preview table). Download CSV button (GET /api/reports/:type?format=csv, triggers file download via Blob + URL.createObjectURL).
Run `cd campus-x/frontend && npm run build` — exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: Logged in as admin: /admin/analytics renders with 4 stat cards, 4 charts (may show empty/zero data), and alerts panel
Logged in as admin: /campus-map renders building selector; selecting CSE Block shows floor tabs; selecting a floor shows blueprint or room grid
Clicking a room on the map opens RoomDetailPanel with room details and correct status badge (text + color + icon)
StatusLegend shows all 5 statuses with text labels (not just colors)
Logged in as admin: /admin/buildings shows table of 5 seeded buildings
Logged in as admin: /admin/timetable shows week grid with seeded entries for CSE Sem5 SecA
Logged in as admin: /admin/complaints shows complaint table with filter controls
Logged in as admin: /admin/optimization shows 'Analyse Semester' button
Logged in as admin: /admin/simulation shows scenario selector and Run Simulation button
Logged in as guest: /campus-map only shows public room types (no FACULTY_CABIN, STAFF_ROOM rows)
verification: npm run dev, open http://localhost:5173, login as admin, navigate each admin route and verify no console errors
